long_biography.plain_text:
At Haddon House, David H. Anderson Jr. helped manage the speciality-food distributor established by his grandfather. As executive vice-president, he described improvements to supply chains, sales staffing, customer support and information systems. His father, David Sr., remained president when the family agreed to sell the business to United Natural Foods.

Anderson also worked alongside his father at Flavor Delite, a seasoning packer that grew to carry several branded food lines. David Sr. was its president while his son served as secretary and treasurer. David Jr. later became president and director. The company continues to market Jane’s Krazy Mixed-Up Seasonings alongside David’s kosher products and Cerulean Seas food specialities.

The company continues to market Jane’s Krazy Mixed-Up Seasonings alongside David’s kosher products and Cerulean Seas food specialities.
